defect1_roster_orientation.proof: tools/promo-video/proof-roster-full/ (94 PNGs + PROOF_STEP2.md with verification table)
defect1_roster_orientation.unrigged_decision: EXCLUDE from walk-test (0 bones), flag for rigging queue. Can appear in static poses.
defect1_roster_orientation.result: All 47 rigged models verified: chest faces travel direction, feet grounded, no crab-walk.

defect2_procedural_animation.root_cause: Travel speed 0.79-1.43 m/s vs clip natural 0.55 m/s → foot skating. Clip is real CMU mocap (PASS retarget), same as owner-approved El Toro video.
defect2_procedural_animation.note: Arm swing (97deg max) is in the mocap itself, not a retarget artifact. Acceptable as it's the reference clip.

defect3_mesh_stretching.root_cause: SHADOW ARTIFACT, not mesh deformation. Shadow pass ran before skeleton.update(), using stale bind-pose bone matrices. With broken weights, stale matrices → cone-shaped garbage shadow. Mesh was always fine (proven: hidemesh, nocast, vertMotion tests).
defect3_mesh_stretching.fix: skeleton.update() before renderer.render() in cinematic.html, cinematic-faction.html, walk-test.html
defect3_mesh_stretching.additional: Roster-wide weight audit found 30-63% stray weights (leg verts bound to Head/Neck/Arms). Built cleanStrayWeights + autoSkinByDistance repair tools in reskin.js. Weights are broken but were NOT the visible defect.

promo_status: DO NOT ASSEMBLE until owner signs off on all three defects.

defect4_hip_pivot.root_cause: Stray skin weights: verts bound to anatomically-impossible bones. MAIME: waist verts (Y~0.1) bound 100% to LeftForeArm → 0.56m fan when arm rotates. BANNON: hip verts bound to Arm → spike; 63.7% stray transfer. Inverse bind matrices verified correct (0.00 error); bones positioned correctly. Pure weight assignment bug.
defect4_hip_pivot.fix: cleanStrayWeights() at load time via NEEDS_WEIGHT_REPAIR set in reskin.js. Applied in walk-test.html, cinematic.html, cinematic-faction.html.
defect4_hip_pivot.verified: MAIME fan eliminated; BANNON spike eliminated; rest pose intact (pixel-identical); walk-test frames clean for both. BANNON still twists at extreme (>60°) angles — acceptable for promo motions.

wwe_do_not_touch.directive: Owner 2026-10-06: WWE models are already reskinned canon versions. Never remove, flag, or exclude.
wwe_do_not_touch.implementation: DO_NOT_TOUCH_WEIGHTS set in reskin.js (BILL_DOZER, JUDAS x7, MARKS, SOMBRA_NEGRA). Weight repair skips these explicitly. QA gates treat flags as false positives.
wwe_do_not_touch.note: John Ford (Cena) filename not identified — not in cast/ under obvious name. Does not affect the skip logic.

portability.directive: Owner 2026-10-06: fixes must apply to Brutal Fist and Bannon, not just AshLane.
portability.staging_js: Game-agnostic: no hardcoded paths, handles Mixamo+C4D skeletons via FAMILY_ALIASES, auto-detects forward. Port by copying staging.js + reskin.js.
portability.reskin_js: cleanStrayWeights scale-invariant (derives regions from model's own bones). NEEDS_* sets are per-roster; replace for target game.
portability.qa_gates: qa/video-qa.py is game-agnostic (ground/crabwalk/geometry/frozen). No hardcoded game logic.

game_differences.brutal_fist: PS1 low-poly INTENTIONAL — do NOT run weight repair; QA geometry gate (2.5x spike) may false-positive on long low-poly tris, tune per game.
game_differences.bannon: Same XFER transfer pipeline as AshLane — NEEDS_WEIGHT_REPAIR applies; maintain per-roster DO_NOT_TOUCH list.
game_differences.ashlane: 1.85m height normalization in walk-test.html is AshLane-specific (Bannon uses per-character scale metadata).
